level: finite engineering integration; no semantic implementation or mathematical promotion
question: Does the unchanged minimal consumer retain its three frozen outcomes when the existing bounded-acceptance workflow supplies the request through an absolute GITHUB_WORKSPACE path, with all integration gates passing on the same PR head?

imports.status: Prior failure and dedicated success remain separately scoped historical outcomes; no automatic fuel reset.

interface.justification: Absolute host filesystem coordinates survive Cargo's crate-local test working directory; this changes no request bytes or semantic identity and is not an Adva content exchange.

allowed_edits: Replace only the request_file assignment in .github/workflows/bounded-acceptance.yml with the absolute coordinate.
Add this contract and append integration provenance to the existing research note.
protected_obligations: Preserve the fixture, consumer, producer, three assertions and all historical contracts/outcomes byte-for-byte.
Retain exact SHA-256 checks, producer import/call ban, strict request shape, module/profile/leaf/occurrence/snapshot checks and existing resource limits.
Preserve Cargo and machine locks and all existing workflow regression commands.
No stable API, semantic identity, certificate, catalog or cross-repository authority changes.

budget.integration_enforcement: One source update triggers CI, two consumer workflows, machine continuity and push/pull_request publication checks. Existing job/command limits remain; unconfigured CI/publication jobs retain GitHub's finite default job timeout. No new source update or retry is allocated. A merge triggers the existing CI/publication/machine workflows once.
budget.memory: Unchanged hosted-runner capacity and consumer byte/outer-item checks; no new RSS cap is asserted. Retain dedicated workflow time/RSS measurements; unmeasured quantities stay missing.

acceptance.checker: Unchanged Rust assertions plus exact pins and producer-dependency ban; inspect actual workflow job logs.
acceptance.success: Both three-case workflows and all integration gates succeed at the new head; review that head, merge with an expected-head lease, and verify main and its checks.
acceptance.failure: A completed assertion differs, a frozen file changes, or a protected identity/dependency check fails; retain evidence and do not merge.
acceptance.unknown: Missing evidence, compilation/harness/environment failure, resource exhaustion or incomplete gate; retain the residual and do not merge.

recording.destination: Commit-anchored review on https://github.com/mountain/adva/pull/230, with final main confirmation in the same PR discussion.
recording.reason: Do not create a result-only source commit that silently triggers another finite run.

claim_boundary: One exact minimal consumer's envelope and canonical snapshot acceptance/refusal only. Not full native certificate verification or authentication, arbitrary-input validation, Research 0090 coverage, Research 0092 promotion, M6 filling, arithmetic universality or a general arithmetic conclusion.
